references.text: Moses led the flock to Horeb, the mountain of God, where the Lord spoke to him from the burning bush.
Israel came to the wilderness of Sinai and camped before the mountain where God revealed himself.
The Lord commanded Israel to break camp at Sinai and continue their journey toward the promised land.
Moses reminds the people of the day they stood before the Lord at Horeb when God spoke to them.
The Lord our God made a covenant with Israel at Horeb.
At Horeb, Israel provoked the Lord's anger, a reminder of the significance of that place.
Elijah traveled to Horeb, the mountain of God, the same place where the Lord spoke to Moses and Israel.
Malachi reminds them of the law given to Moses at Horeb for all Israel.
Stephen tells how the Lord revealed himself to Moses at Mount Sinai.
Paul mentions Mount Sinai in connection with the covenant and the law that was given there.
